jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist - USA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary 

As an AI Deployment Strategist, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral’s AI solutions, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation. This role sits at the intersection of business strategy, AI innovation, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes.

 

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps, collaborate with the Applied AI team to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to customer success, bridging the gap between strategy and execution.

 

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex business challenges, and are passionate about turning AI potential into real-world impact.

 

What you will do

 

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

• Lead executive-level workshops to identify business challenges and opportunities where Mistral’s AI can drive step-change improvements.

• Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the “art of the possible” and a clear path to value.

• Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases, quantify ROI, and align solutions with customer objectives.

 

AI Solution Design & Deployment

• Architect end-to-end AI solutions, integrating Mistral’s models and platform into customer workflows and technical infrastructure.

• Partner with the Applied AI team to design, prototype, and deploy AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

• Own the execution of pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

 

Value Realization & Customer Success

• Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding their AI strategy and ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral.

• Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to business outcomes, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

• Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral’s internal teams, synthesizing feedback to influence product and research roadmaps.

• Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks to scale go-to-market efforts and ensure consistent delivery excellence.

• Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment.

 
 

About you

 

• 4+ years in a client-facing strategic and technical role (e.g., data science consulting, value engineering, or technical sales).

• You hold a degree in a relevant scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, etc.)

• Foundational knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science, with the credibility to advise both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to demonstrate value.

• Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous challenges into actionable solutions.

• Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level).

• Hands on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python)

• Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a collaborative environment.

• Experience with sales qualification frameworks (e.g., MEDDPICC) and value-based selling is a plus.

 

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead, Fleet Delivery
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

A datacenter is not a cloud until software makes it one. You will lead the team that turns arriving hardware into accepted clusters.

Cabling validation, burn-in, firmware, deployment validation, software stack install — all of it automated, none of it click-ops. Your KPI is time to acceptance: the hours between a rack being physically installed and it serving customer workloads. Across the industry that number is measured in weeks. You will drive it toward days, then hours, as we scale toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe.

This is a founding leadership role at the intersection of hardware and software. Early on it is deliberately hands-on: most of your time in the code and the architecture, some of it on datacenter floors, because the automation has to survive contact with the machines it runs on.

But the job is building and leading a team from day one — hiring your first engineers, coaching them, setting their growth paths, and running the rituals that keep quality high. As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You shape this new team's charter and set the standard for how every future Mistral datacenter comes online.

What You Will Do

  • Build the delivery pipeline in Go: provisioning, configuration, validation, burn-in, network bring-up, software stack install.

  • Build the team from scratch: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own their performance and growth paths — and set the tooling standards and the playbook every future site reuses.

  • Own time-to-acceptance and drive it down relentlessly — measure it, break it down, kill the slowest step first.

  • Work shoulder-to-shoulder with Hardware Design and Fleet Health — reliability starts at delivery.

  • Handle GPU fleets at scale: H100 and GB200-class nodes, InfiniBand and RoCE fabrics, and the failure modes they bring.

  • Partner with Product Managers and the datacenter org to plan delivery waves against capacity commitments.

What We're Looking For

  • You have automated bare-metal fleets — you have written the software that turns racks into clusters. If you have done it by hand, you resented it and scripted it.

  • Hardware fluency: servers, GPUs, NICs, switches, firmware — you can read a parts list and a topology diagram.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems, with at least 2 years leading engineers — real people leadership: you have hired, coached, and grown engineers, not just set technical direction.

  • Deep Linux: you are comfortable well below the application layer.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • Willing to travel to datacenter sites when the work demands it.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: AI Scientist - Agentic Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

Mistral is looking for AI Scientists with deep ML expertise and hands-on engineering experience to expand what our agentic tools can do across the engineering lifecycle — CAE (CFD, FEA, etc.) and EDA/Semi.

Working within the AI4Engineering Science team, your core work is building the pre and post-training data for Mistral's LLMs to reason about and execute real engineering tasks. Because Mistral trains its own frontier LLMs, the data and verifiers you design ship directly into models you can hold, a rare position, and the core of the job.

Alongside this, you'll help shape the agent architectures and harness that let these models operate reliably inside multi-step engineering workflows, not just answer isolated questions.

You'll work closely with domain experts across CAE and EDA or other domains to ground this work in how engineers actually work, and with the broader research team to translate that domain grounding into training signal and evaluation benchmarks that measure genuine task competence.

This is early-stage work, and that's the point: you'd be joining at the foundation, shaping the data, verifiers, and agent scaffolding that decide whether these systems become reliable or stay demo-grade. There's no inherited playbook, you'll help define what good looks like, and your work will set the direction the team builds on rather than extend an existing one.

What you will do

  • Design pretraining, SFT, and RL data for engineering tasks across CAD, CAE, and semiconductor/EDA

  • Define verifiers and evaluation criteria that capture what "correct" and "high-quality" actually mean for each engineering task, beyond surface-level plausibility

  • Design and improve agent architectures and harnesses: how models plan, call tools, recover from errors, and chain steps together across long-horizon engineering workflows

  • Build evaluation benchmarks and diagnostic tooling to identify where models fail on engineering tasks, and trace those failures back to gaps in data, reward design, or agent scaffolding

  • Collaborate with domain experts across CAE and EDA or other domains (and the science and solutions teams more broadly) to identify which engineering workflows are highest-value to target next

  • Contribute to Mistral's broader pre and post-training research, sharing findings and methodology across the science organization

What we're looking for

  • Fluent English with excellent communication skills, able to explain technical ML and engineering concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences

  • Deep, hands-on machine learning expertise, particularly LLM development

  • Demonstrated experience running, debugging, and validating real engineering workflows in at least one of CAD, CAE, semiconductor simulation, or EDA

  • You write clean, readable Python code and are comfortable in Linux/HPC environments

  • Self-directed, you don't need detailed roadmaps to make progress

  • Low-ego, collaborative, and eager to learn at the intersection of engineering and ML

It would be great if you

  • Have experience building or fine-tuning agentic systems (tool use, multi-step planning, agent orchestration frameworks)

  • Have experience with reward modeling, RLHF/RLAIF/RLVR, or preference-based training

  • Have industrial or academic experience with CAE or EDA tools (e.g. SolidWorks, CATIA, Fluent, Abaqus, LS-DYNA, STAR-CCM+, Cadence/Synopsys/Siemens EDA tools)

  • Have contributed to a large open-source or industry codebase

  • Have publications in engineering and ML venues (NeurIPS, ICLR, JFM, AIAA, etc.)

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will own our Kubernetes product end to end: a metal-to-on-demand platform built on in-house infrastructure, with GPU support for training, inference, and general-purpose compute.

Kubernetes is our product, not just our platform — we run it on infrastructure we own end to end. You will decide how the control plane scales, how GPUs get scheduled, and how quickly a rack of bare metal becomes an on-demand cluster a customer can use. The decisions you make here shape how our infrastructure scales from today's footprint to a gigawatt, and how we turn frontier AI research into production systems used by millions.

This is a role for an engineer who leads from the front because that is where the work is, not because management was the next rung on the ladder.

What You Will Do

  • Design and ship the control plane. You build alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions — scheduling, operators, provisioning, node lifecycle.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software. You set the standard for ownership, remove the obstacles in their way, and coach them past their comfort zone until the work they ship surprises them.

  • Own the reliability of the Kubernetes control plane. It is the team's headline KPI. You make the calls when it breaks at 3am, and your engineers learn from how you do it.

  • Shrink the distance from metal to on-demand. Provisioning a cluster should be minutes of automation, not weeks of tickets.

  • Partner with Product Managers to set priorities, scope initiatives, and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback — the leadership work that never becomes someone else's job.

  • Define the team's processes and execution rituals as it grows.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You have run Kubernetes in anger — and ideally built parts of it: operators, schedulers, controllers. You understand what happens underneath it, and you have worked on Linux directly, not just on managed services that sit on top of it.

  • You have run GPU workloads on Kubernetes, or you are confident you can own that domain fast.

  • You think like a developer who happens to build infrastructure, not an operator who manages it. You write code other engineers depend on.

  • Extensive experience building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The team

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a founding people-leadership role. There is no team to inherit and no legacy to maintain — you build the team as well as the stack, and you are accountable for both from day one. Early on you will be deliberately hands-on, because there is no one else to solve the hardest problems — but hiring your first engineers, coaching them, and setting their growth paths starts immediately, not later. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

You will be the founding Engineering Team Lead for storage on our cloud.

Block, filesystem, and object storage for training runs, sandboxed workloads, and general compute: you decide what we build, what we buy, and how it adds up to storage our customers can bet a business on. Some layers we deploy and harden from best-in-class vendors. The ones that matter most we write ourselves in Go — S3-compatible object storage, tiering, backup and recovery, caching layers that put cold data on cheap spinning disks.

As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You will own capacity planning across datacenters and the architecture that keeps data durable when disks, networks, and entire sites fail. Storage is a strategic bet for this org: the team you build and the calls you make will define how a gigawatt of European compute stores its data.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the storage stack — block, file, object — for training, sandbox, and general compute workloads.

  • Make the build-vs-buy calls: deploy and harden vendor platforms where they win; design and write our own services in Go where they don't.

  • Own the data plane: allocation, duplication, tiering, backup and recovery, S3-compatible APIs.

  • Plan capacity across datacenters and across failure domains — petabytes, not terabytes.

  • Build the team from zero: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own performance and growth paths, and set the standard for ownership.

  • Partner with Product Managers to shape the storage roadmap and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • You have built storage systems — object, block, or distributed filesystems — not just operated them. You know what happens when a disk dies mid-write and when a rebalance collides with a backup window.

  • Deep distributed-systems fundamentals: durability, consistency, replication, erasure coding, failure domains.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Systems engineers coming from C++ or Rust who are ready to write Go daily should still talk to us.

  • You are comfortable with hardware reality: HDD, SSD, and NVMe tiers, and the economics of each.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

We run it all on our own metal, our own network, our own datacenters — which means when something breaks, the fix is ours to write.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

  • A low-ego, team-first mindset. We care less about your exact domain and more about whether you are the kind of technical force other engineers want to work alongside.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager - ASEAN
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

ASEAN is one of Mistral’s most important and fastest-growing markets in APAC. We’re looking for a Field Marketing Manager to build and lead our marketing presence across ASEAN, Hong Kong, and Taiwan.

This is a highly entrepreneurial role and a new position within the team. You’ll have the opportunity to shape how Mistral shows up across a diverse set of markets — from Singapore and Indonesia to Malaysia, Thailand, Hong Kong, and Taiwan — working closely with regional sales, global marketing, partners, customers, and senior stakeholders.

You’ll bring together two important parts of our go-to-market strategy.

First, sovereign and public sector. You’ll help build trusted relationships with government and public sector organizations through thoughtful executive engagement, policy-led conversations, roundtables, and high-touch experiences.

Second, enterprise growth. You’ll work with sales to build demand and accelerate opportunities across some of the region’s most important and highly regulated organizations, including financial institutions, telecommunications companies, energy businesses, and other strategic accounts.

This is an opportunity to build the playbook rather than inherit one. You’ll have significant ownership over strategy and execution, with the autonomy to experiment, move quickly, and see a direct connection between your work and Mistral’s growth in the region.

What you'll do

Create exceptional field experiences

  • Own the strategy and execution of regional events, industry conferences, executive briefings, customer experiences, and intimate leadership gatherings.

  • Develop experiences that go beyond traditional events — creating meaningful conversations between Mistral, customers, partners, and industry leaders.

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution, from developing the program concept to being on-site to make it happen.

Craft the regional marketing strategy

  • Develop and execute Mistral’s field marketing strategy across ASEAN, Hong Kong, and Taiwan, translating global priorities into locally relevant programs.

  • Work closely with regional sales leadership to identify market opportunities, priority accounts, and the programs that can have the greatest commercial impact.

  • Build scalable approaches that can work across diverse markets while retaining the local relevance needed to engage customers effectively.

  • Establish a clear view of marketing performance, from engagement and account penetration through to pipeline and revenue contribution.

Build trusted relationships with government and public sector

  • Create high-touch marketing programs for government and public sector audiences, including executive roundtables, policy discussions, VIP briefings, and delegation visits.

  • Help position Mistral as a credible and trusted partner in conversations around AI, technology, sovereignty, and digital transformation.

  • Work closely with sales and leadership to create meaningful engagement with senior government and public sector stakeholders.

Accelerate strategic enterprise accounts

  • Partner with enterprise sales teams to develop account-based marketing strategies across priority accounts.

  • Create highly targeted 1:1 and 1:few campaigns designed to open doors, deepen relationships, and accelerate complex sales cycles.

  • Develop programs for strategic accounts across industries such as financial services, telecommunications, energy, and other regulated sectors.

  • Connect campaigns, events, content, and executive engagement into cohesive account strategies that move opportunities forward.

Support the regional ecosystem

  • Develop joint marketing and go-to-market programs with strategic partners, including systems integrators, telcos, technology partners, and global service providers.

  • Work with partners to extend Mistral’s reach across fragmented markets and create new opportunities for customer engagement.

  • Identify new partnership opportunities that can strengthen Mistral’s position across the region.

Bring the region's voice to Mistral

  • Represent the needs, insights, and opportunities of ASEAN, Hong Kong, and Taiwan within the global marketing organization.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Demand Generation to adapt global messaging, campaigns, and assets for local markets.

  • Bring a deep understanding of local customer needs, cultures, regulations, and competitive dynamics to inform our global strategy.

  • Identify what is working in-market and turn those learnings into repeatable approaches across the region.

What we're looking for

  • Experience in field marketing, demand generation, regional marketing, or GTM within enterprise B2B technology, software, AI, infrastructure, or a related environment.

  • Strong experience working across Southeast Asia, Hong Kong and/or Taiwan, with an understanding of the different commercial and cultural dynamics across these markets.

  • Experience marketing to enterprise, regulated, or public sector audiences, ideally with exposure to financial services, telecommunications, energy, or government.

  • Experience creating high-touch executive programs such as roundtables, VIP briefings, customer events, or policy-focused engagements.

  • Strong understanding of account-based marketing, with the ability to build programs around strategic accounts and complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Experience developing joint GTM or co-marketing programs with partners such as GSIs, telcos, hyperscalers, or technology providers.

  • A strong commercial mindset and ability to connect marketing activity to account engagement, pipeline, and business outcomes.

  • Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to build trusted relationships with senior sales leaders, customers, partners, and executives.

  • A strong communicator and storyteller who can represent Mistral confidently with senior audiences.

  • Someone who is highly adaptable and comfortable working across different cultures, markets, and ways of doing business.

  • A hands-on operator who enjoys moving between strategy and execution and isn't afraid to roll up their sleeves.

  • High ownership and low ego: you’re comfortable creating structure where there isn’t one, making decisions quickly, and taking responsibility for the outcome.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

BRING THE REGION'S VOICE TO MISTRAL

 - Represent the needs, insights, and opportunities of ASEAN, Hong Kong, and Taiwan within the global marketing organization.

 - Partner with Product Marketing and Demand Generation to adapt global messaging, campaigns, and assets for local markets.

 - Bring a deep understanding of local customer needs, cultures, regulations, and competitive dynamics to inform our global strategy.

jobs.title: Customer Success, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Mistral, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they achieve their goals using Mistral’s solutions. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success. 

This role is ideal for those who excel in customer-facing environments, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about turning customer success into business impact.

What You Will Do

Customer Success Ownership

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of Mistral’s AI solutions.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

  • Lead customer onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement to drive product usage and satisfaction.

  • Monitor customer health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address challenges to prevent churn.

  • Collaborate with Sales to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage patterns.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to gather customer feedback and influence the product roadmap.

  • Develop and deliver customer training, enablement programs, and best practices to drive adoption.

  • Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) to align on goals, challenges, and success metrics.

Strategic Customer Guidance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them on how to leverage Mistral’s AI solutions to achieve their business outcomes.

  • Work closely with Support and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, from deployment to production.

  • Create and execute customer success plans with clear KPIs, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally, ensuring their voice is heard in product and strategic discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer insights with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to inform product improvements and strategic initiatives.

  • Clear obstacles for customers during deployment and adoption phases, accelerating time-to-value.

  • Support renewal processes, including contract negotiations, expansion discussions, and coordination with internal teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical or SaaS environment.

  • Proven ability to manage enterprise customer relationships, with a focus on driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Experience working with technical products, with the ability to engage confidently with Data, IT, and Engineering teams.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.

  • Business acumen: Ability to identify upsell and expansion opportunities while ensuring customer success.

  • Technical aptitude: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is a plus; ability to understand and discuss technical requirements is essential.

  • Hands-on, customer-centric, collaborative, and organized, with a passion for solving complex challenges.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Recruiting Operations Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Recruiting Operations Manager on the Talent Acquisition team, you will help run the systems, data and processes that let us hire +100 people per month. You will work alongside Talent Acquisition, People Ops, Legal, Finance, and every department that hires. Your job is to make recruiting more effective as we scale: more great hires per unit of effort, without adding unnecessary complexity or sacrificing quality.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of process, technology, and people: someone who loves solving operational challenges and driving continuous improvement.

What You Will Do

  • Recruiting infrastructure & operating model: optimize our ATS, broader recruiting stack, workflows and processes end to end; keep the system clean, connected and scalable.

  • Metrics & performance: build the metrics and reporting that leadership and Ops teams need to make decisions, and turn insights into concrete improvements in speed, quality and efficiency.

  • Headcount planning & recruiting capacity: partner with Finance and business leaders to align workforce plans with business priorities and ensure recruiting capacity stays aligned as priorities evolve.

  • Enable recruiters & hiring managers: build practical enablement around tools, sourcing, workflows, interviewing, hiring principles and calibration so teams can operate more effectively.

  • Candidate experience & recruiting standards: establish a consistent, high-quality candidate experience across the recruiting process, and continuously identify opportunities to improve it

  • Innovation & leverage: use AI, talent intelligence, market data and emerging technologies to augment how we identify, engage and assess talent, creating new sources of leverage as we scale

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in operations, including 2+ years in recruiting, People or HR Operations, ideally in a company that has scaled headcount quickly and navigated significant organizational complexity.

  • Strong systems thinking and attention to detail: you naturally connect the dots, spot inconsistencies and care about getting the underlying system right, not just fixing the symptom.

  • Pragmatic and highly organized: you focus on what will have the biggest impact, can manage multiple complex projects without losing focus, and bring the structure and follow-through needed to get things to the finish line.

  • Curious and hands-on: you have an appetite to vibe-code your way through automation, experiment with AI and new tools, and are comfortable building lightweight solutions yourself.

  • High-agency and positive: you operate independently, turn complex problems into solutions rather than simply raising them, and bring a constructive, can-do mindset to the work.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Head of, Financial Systems Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Head of Financial Systems, you will shape the future of Mistral’s Finance technology ecosystem.

The role exists to build a modern data, systems and AI-driven finance department that bridges finance, data, and business operations to drive financial performance and strategic decision-making.

You’ll collaborate closely with our CFO, our internal Applied AI resources, and teams like, HR, IT, Legal, and Security to assess current systems, identify gaps, and design a target architecture that supports Mistral’s growth.

Your impact will be felt across the organization, from improving profitability to automating accounting and ensuring reliable financial outputs.

 
 

What You Will Do

  • Lead the assessment of Mistral’s current Finance technology landscape, including tools, processes, data flows and pain points.

  • Define and prioritize business, functional, and technical requirements for Finance systems in collaboration with stakeholders.

  • Design a target Finance tech architecture, outlining system roles, integrations, and data flows and architectures

  • Develop a data governance framework, including ownership, quality controls, and maintenance processes.

  • Create and execute a prioritized plan to clean up and rationalize Finance datasets and execute it

  • Deliver a clear recommendation on the future Finance tech setup, including costs, risks, and a transition roadmap.

  • Ensure Finance data is migration-ready by addressing quality issues and defining ownership.

 
 

What We're Looking For

  • Strong project management skills, from defining vision, strategy, and roadmaps, to stelar execution

  • Engineering academic background, ideally from a tier-1 engineering school

  • Deep data architecture knowledge, including mastery of data sources, pipelines, storage, transformation, and metadata management, with hands-on experience designing and implementing architectures (e.g., APIs, workflows, BigQuery, DBT).

  • GenAI power user with Vibe coding skills, automation expertise, and experience building scalable, impactful products in a professional context. Basic coding skills and software development experience are a strong plus.

  • Experience in Finance technology assessment, system selection, and knowledge of tools such as SAP S4H, Kyriba, Lago, Payflows, etc

  • Solid financial knowledge, including experience working alongside finance teams, understanding FP&A, accounting, cash management, and procurement, and a strong interest in driving value through process automation and efficiency.

  • Builder and scaler with experience structuring IT systems (preferably in finance), building and scaling IT teams or departments from the ground up, and operating in multicountry environments.

  • Proven ability to build tools and processes from scratch to support company growth.

  • Strong analytical skills to evaluate data quality, consistency, and relevance.

  • Proficiency in prioritization and the use of performance metrics to drive impact.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Solution Operations Manager, Verticalization
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a direct business partner to our Solutions team, including Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers, you will work closely with Solutions leadership to roll out Mistral’s Industry Verticals & Capabilities framework across pre-sales and post-sales activities.

You will translate the framework into a scalable operating model by defining processes, governance, playbooks, KPIs, and resourcing plans; coordinating Vertical and Capability owners; and embedding reusable approaches into customer engagements. You will also analyze performance and delivery capacity to continuously improve execution.

This role is critical to turning our go-to-market strategy into repeatable action—aligning customer priorities, technical expertise, and delivery resources to improve the efficiency and impact of our Solutions organization and accelerate the value Mistral delivers to customers.

What You Will Do

Technical Go-to-Market Execution

  • Partner with Solutions leadership to orchestrate and support the industry verticals & capabilities matrix motion, helping translate strategic GTM definitions into repeatable execution

  • Help codify and scale vertical and capability playbooks (ICP assumptions, priority use cases, delivery approaches, reusable assets) to enable re-use across accounts

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Vertical and Capability owners to align on prioritization, resourcing, and enablement for pre-sales and post-sales engagements

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with sales teams, product development, and revenue operations to align technical implementation capabilities with customer needs

  • Support the development of professional services offerings and technical engagement models that maximize customer success

  • Collaborate with product & engineering teams to ensure Solutions team feedback is incorporated into the product roadmap

  • Help prepare materials for executive reviews highlighting technical implementation successes and challenges

Data-Driven Decision Support

  • Identify and operationalize the right metrics to optimize the Solutions team impact on customer success & revenue

  • Create and maintain reporting mechanisms around technical implementation KPIs

  • Synthesize tangible, strategic recommendations that can be deployed cross-functionally

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in strategic operations, operations, chief of staff within technical sales, solutions engineering, or professional services environments.

  • Strong ability to bring structure to ambiguity and drive complex, cross-functional initiatives from strategy through execution.

  • Proven track record in optimizing processes, impacting business KPIs, and aligning resources with business priorities.

  • Exceptional negotiation and diplomacy skills: ability to navigate complex stakeholder dynamics and align competing priorities.

  • Hands-on, execution-focused mindset with a bias for action in ambiguous, fast-changing environments.

  • Technical acumen and AI fluency: understanding of AI implementation, use cases, and scaling challenges.

  • Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or advanced degree preferred.

  • Fluency in English (native level); additional European languages are a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: CyberSecurity, Offensive Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

At Mistral AI, we’re pushing the boundaries of what’s possible with agentic systems—building products like Mistral Studio and Mistral Vibe that redefine how users interact with AI.

As an Offensive Security Pentester, you’ll play a pivotal role in safeguarding these innovations by anticipating, identifying, and mitigating risks before they materialize. This isn’t just about finding vulnerabilities; it’s about shaping the future of secure AI by embedding an attacker’s mindset into everything we build.

You’ll work at the intersection of offensive security, AI safety, and product development, collaborating with cross-functional teams to harden our systems against evolving threats. Your expertise will directly influence how we design, deploy, and protect our most critical assets, ensuring our agents remain resilient, trustworthy, and ahead of adversaries.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in dynamic environments, where creativity, technical depth, and a passion for security converge to solve unprecedented challenges.

 

What you will do

 

  • Proactively hunt for vulnerabilities in the interactions between our agentic applications, cloud infrastructure, and foundational models, with a focus on realistic, high-impact attack vectors.

  • Design and execute red and purple team exercises, simulating sophisticated adversarial scenarios to stress-test our defenses and refine our detection capabilities.

  • Partner with defensive teams to translate offensive insights into actionable improvements, from detection engineering to incident response.

  • Conduct in-depth penetration testing across our product suite, including AI-driven workflows, custom infrastructure, and user-facing interfaces.

  • Build and automate offensive tooling to scale your impact, leveraging cutting-edge techniques to stay ahead of emerging threats.

  • Communicate findings with clarity and conviction, ensuring technical and non-technical stakeholders understand risks and prioritize mitigations effectively.

  • Shape Mistral AI’s security strategy by contributing attacker-informed perspectives to threat modeling, risk assessment, and architectural decisions.

 

About you

 

You’re likely a strong fit if you bring:

  • 7+ years of offensive security experience, with a track record of identifying and exploiting subtle vulnerabilities in complex systems—or equivalent expertise demonstrated through exceptional achievements.

  • Deep knowledge of AI/ML security risks, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and abuses of dynamic UI components.

  • Hands-on experience assessing modern technology stacks, such as:

    • Custom Kubernetes deployments and containerized environments

    • Cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

    • CI/CD pipelines and GitHub security best practices

    • macOS/Linux internals and Python/React-based applications

    • Data science toolchains and AI/ML infrastructure

  • A builder’s mindset: The ability to write robust tools, automate offensive workflows, and contribute to defensive solutions in complex codebases.

  • Strong intuition for trust boundaries and risk assessment in fast-moving, high-stakes environments.

  • Outstanding communication skills, with the ability to distill technical nuances into compelling narratives that drive change.

  • A collaborative spirit, eager to work alongside engineers, researchers, and product teams to embed security into every phase of development.

Now, it would be ideal if you had experience with:

  • Background in AI, data science, or related fields, with an understanding of how security intersects with model behavior and system design.

  • Experience in high-growth startups or research-driven organizations, where agility and innovation are paramount.

  • Expertise in adjacent disciplines, such as software engineering, detection engineering, SRE, or security architecture.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, CyberSecurity
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to build the customer-facing cyber service and use-cases on top of our cyber harnesses. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing red-team/blue-team agentic workflows, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients.

Your work will bridge the gap between our foundational cyber harnesses and the agentic solutions that clients deploy. While SWE-Cyber makes the platform robust and scalable, and Pentesters run the solution and guide the direction, you will focus on building the agentic use-cases and client-facing service that solve real security problems.

 

What you will do

Client-Facing Agentic Solutions
• Compose red-team / blue-team agentic workflows for production use-cases
• Configure harnesses for cloud defense, vulnerability scanning, dynamic red-teaming, and penetration testing scenarios
• Work directly on client use-cases, translating security requirements into agentic solutions
• Turn prototype agents into deployed services that clients rely on

Context Engineering & Orchestration
• Design and implement context engineering that enables agents to operate effectively in cybersecurity domains
• Orchestrate multi-agent systems for complex security workflows
• Build the agentic layer that sits between the harness and the client

Service Delivery
• Ship fast and iterate based on client feedback and real-world performance
• Operate independently while leveraging internal building blocks and frameworks
• Collaborate with pentesters to ensure domain accuracy and effectiveness
• Partner with SWE-Cyber to ensure the platform supports your use-case requirements

 

About you

• Strong applied AI engineer with hands-on experience building agents, LLM orchestration, context engineering, evals, and RAG systems
• You ship fast, with a bias toward action and delivery
• Operate independently with a customer-led mindset
• Able to reuse internal components and bricks effectively
• Some cyber context is a real plus, but not mandatory - we can pair you with pentesters for domain depth
• Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills and collaborative attitude

It would be ideal if you also have:
• Genuine cyber or pentest knowledge
• Experience building agentic harnesses or multi-agent systems end-to-end
• Strong background in evals and benchmarking of agent systems
• Experience with security tooling or workflows
• Prior work on production AI systems in regulated or high-stakes environments

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a People Operations Manager on the People team, you will build, scale, and maintain the operational foundation that supports our team in France. This role exists to ensure our daily HR processes run seamlessly, keeping the company fully compliant while delivering a reliable, clear, and high-quality experience for every employee.

You will act as the primary point of contact for employee lifecycle milestones, everyday operations, and external vendor relations. Your impact will be felt directly through the precision of our monthly payroll, the clarity of our internal policies, and the efficiency of our onboarding systems.

This position requires a balanced blend of hands-on administrative execution and process engineering. You will own the full operational landscape—from local labor contracts and complex immigration cases to scaling our HRIS software—while constantly identifying opportunities to automate workflows and reduce friction.

What You Will Do

  • Process payroll end-to-end for France-based employees, collaborating closely with external providers and our internal Finance team to ensure timely, precise execution.

  • Own the onboarding journey, managing labor contracts, amendments, certificates, and system updates so new hires are integrated accurately from day one.

  • Navigate immigration and mobility requests, directly managing work permits, visa renewals, and National Security Number applications.

  • Resolve daily employee inquiries regarding benefits administration, enrollment changes, and company policies with clear and prompt support.

  • Maintain compliance infrastructure, regularly updating employee handbooks and monitoring shifts in French employment law to protect the company.

  • Lead HR software initiatives and vendor management projects to evaluate, implement, and refine our HRIS and payroll tools.

  • Streamline operational workflows by documenting, automating, and auditing existing procedures to eliminate administrative bottlenecks.

jobs.title: AI Deployment Strategist, Science - EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As an AI Deployment Strategist with Science Focus, you will drive the adoption and deployment of Mistral's AI solutions for science-heavy projects, working closely with customers from strategic vision to production implementation in domains like computer vision, robotics, and embodied AI.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical expertise, business strategy, and hands-on deployment, ensuring our customers achieve transformative outcomes in specialized AI applications.

You will partner with senior executives to design AI roadmaps for science-driven use cases, collaborate with the Applied AI and Research teams to deliver solutions in production, and ensure seamless transitions from presales to postsales. Your work will directly contribute to expanding Mistral's capabilities in cutting-edge AI domains.

This role is ideal for those who thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex technical challenges in specialized domains, and are passionate about turning AI science into real-world impact.

 

What You Will Do

Strategic Discovery & Vision Setting

  • Lead executive-level workshops to identify science-specific business challenges and opportunities where Mistral's AI can drive step-change improvements in vision, robotics, embodied AI, and other specialized domains.

  • Co-create AI adoption roadmaps with customers, articulating the "art of the possible" in science applications and a clear path to value.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to develop business cases for technically complex, science-driven solutions, quantify ROI, and align with customer objectives.

AI Solution Design & Deployment (Science Focus)

  • Architect end-to-end AI solutions for specialized domains, integrating Mistral's models and platform into science-specific workflows and technical infrastructure.

  • Partner with the Applied AI and Research teams to design, prototype, and deploy science-focused AI solutions in production, ensuring scalability and impact.

  • Own the execution of science-heavy pilot projects and proofs-of-value, demonstrating the potential of our technology in specialized domains and paving the way for full-scale deployment.

Value Realization & Customer Success

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers on science-driven AI strategies, ensuring they maximize the value of their investment in Mistral's specialized capabilities.

  • Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) tied to technical and business outcomes in science domains, and communicate progress to executive sponsors.

  • Proactively identify expansion opportunities within accounts for science applications, building on initial successes to drive long-term partnerships.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the bridge between customers and Mistral's Research and Applied AI teams, synthesizing feedback to influence science-focused product and research roadmaps.

  • Develop reusable assets, best practices, and playbooks for science domain deployments to scale go-to-market efforts.

  • Travel (~30-60%) to foster deep client relationships and support on-site deployment of specialized solutions.

 

 

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years in a client-facing technical role (e.g., data science consulting, research engineering, or technical sales) with strong background in AI science domains (computer vision, robotics, embodied AI, etc.)

  • You hold a degree in a scientific field (e.g., Computer Science, Robotics, Physics, Mathematics) - PhD is a plus

  • Deep technical knowledge of AI/ML/Data Science with specialization in science domains, and the credibility to advise highly technical audiences

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying science-focused AI applications (Python, C++, or similar) to demonstrate value in specialized domains

  • Strong business acumen and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value

  • Executive presence and communication skills to influence senior stakeholders (VP, C-level) on technically advanced solutions

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying AI applications (Python) in science domains

  • Resilient, results-driven, and comfortable leading through influence in a highly technical, collaborative environment

  • Experience with research-to-production transitions and working with research teams is a plus

Why This Role Matters You will play a pivotal role in shaping how enterprises adopt and deploy AI, ensuring Mistral’s solutions deliver measurable impact. By partnering with the Applied AI team, you’ll help turn strategic visions into production-ready solutions, making Mistral an indispensable partner for our customers.

 
 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Engineering Team Lead, DevEx
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

 

On average, our team leads are responsible for teams of about five people, owning both execution and delivery while remaining hands-on. You will split your time dynamically between individual contribution and leadership, with the balance shifting as your team grows.

 

You will collaborate closely with engineering teams to ship improvements that directly accelerate development velocity, enhance code quality, and streamline workflows across our AI platform and products: AI Studio, Le Chat, and Mistral Vibe. You will be responsible for creating a strong team culture, setting clear processes, raising the developer experience bar, and ensuring consistent high-quality delivery of developer tooling and infrastructure.

 

This is a highly critical role at the intersection of developer productivity, infrastructure, and people. You will help shape how our engineering organization builds at scale. If you enjoy building developer platforms, leading ambitious engineers, and shipping tooling that supercharges productivity, this role is for you.

 

What you will do

 

• Empower Your Team: Act as the clear point of contact for your team and its projects. Remove obstacles, unblock execution, and create an environment where engineers can focus on building impactful developer tools and platforms.

 

• Lead Delivery and Accountability: Own the delivery of your team’s roadmap for developer experience improvements, including projects like enhancing CI/CD and build systems, optimizing cloud registries (Docker, Azure, GCP), implementing static and dynamic code analysis tools, and automated vulnerability analysis. Ensure projects are shipped with the right level of quality, reliability, and performance.

 

• Bridge Engineering and Productivity: Partner closely with engineering teams to define the roadmap and priorities for developer experience. Scope initiatives, estimate engineering effort, and drive prioritization decisions based on developer productivity impact and technical necessity. Keep the whole team involved and engaged in the product direction.

 

• Hands-on Technical Leadership: Stay deeply involved in architecture design, system design, coding, peer reviews, and technical decision-making for developer tooling. Lead by example and remain connected to the day-to-day challenges of the team.

 

• Process and Clarity: Define and evolve team processes, best practices, and execution rituals for developer workflows. Ensure they remain relevant as the team and product scale.

 

• Raise the bar: Challenge engineers to step up, take ownership, and grow beyond their comfort zone. Increase the team’s bus factor through knowledge sharing, documentation, and rotation of responsibilities. Champion a culture of continuous improvement in developer productivity.

 
 

About you

 

• 5+ years of relevant professional work experience in Developer Experience (DevEx), DevOps, or related fields.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Proficiency in scripting and programming languages (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go) and experience with infrastructure as code tools.

• Experience with building and leading high-performing teams in developer tooling or infrastructure.

• Experience working with cross-functional teams including product, design, and business.

• Experience with project management and planning for infrastructure and tooling initiatives.

• Ownership and capacity to ship developer tooling and platforms end-to-end.

• Strong experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins), cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure), build systems, container registries, and developer tooling.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

The Role

 

We are looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to support Mistral AI’s GDPR compliance strategy by being the product and engineering teams' closest partner and advisor, and drafting compliance documentation.

• Negotiate DPAs with Mistral AI’s providers and customers

• Monitor privacy regulations and supervisory authorities guidance or decisions
