jobs.title: Applied AI, Forward Deployed Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

Mistral AI is seeking a Applied AI Engineer to facilitate the adoption of its products among customers and collaborate with them to address complex technical challenges.

 

The Applied AI Engineer will be an integral part of our Applied AI Engineering team, which is dedicated to driving the successful deployment of Mistral AI products. They will work hand-in-hand with customers from the pre-sale stage to post-implementation, ensuring our solutions meet and exceed client expectations. 

 

In this role, you’ll manage daily customer relations involving multiple stakeholders (CEO/CTO, data scientists, and software engineers) and function as a key resource in externalising our research in production settings.

 

What You Will Do

 

• You’ll be responsible for onboarding customers on our products and APIs, providing guidance on prompting, evaluation, and fine-tuning, and ensuring the best production integration with back-end and front-end interfaces. 

• You’ll work on state-of-the-art GenAI applications from consumer products to industrial use cases, driving with our customers a crucial technological transformation. 

• You’ll individually help deploy into production use cases with a considerable business impact across various industries. 

• You’ll work in collaboration with our researchers, other AI engineers, product engineers on our most complex customer projects involving complex fine-tuning, state-of-the-art LLM applications, and contributing to our open source codebases for tasks such as inference and fine-tuning.

• You’ll be involved in pre-sales calls to understand potential clients' needs, challenges, and aspirations. You will provide technical guidance on our products and explain Mistral technologies to various stakeholders. 

• Your collaboration with our product and science team to improve continuously our product and model capabilities based on customers’ feedback  

 

What We're Looking For

 

• You are fluent in English

• You hold a PhD / master in AI / data science.

• You have 2+ years as a technical individual contributor (data scientist or software engineer) on AI-based products

• You have experience in Fine Tuning LLMs, tackling advanced RAG or agentic use cases

• You have deep understanding of concepts and algorithms underlying machine learning and LLMs

• You're experienced with building and deploying LLMs or NLP applications

• You have proven experience in AI or machine learning product implementation with APIs, back-end and front-end interfaces.

• You have strong technical coding skills in Python

• You have experience with deep learning with Pytorch

• You have experience with agents framework such as Langchain, vector DBs

• You hold strong communication skills with an ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple terms with technical and non-technical audiences

 

Ideally you have:

 

• Contributed to open-source projects in particular in the space of LLMs

• Experience as a Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect or Technical Product Manager

 
 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME), you will bridge the gap between Mistral's science/engineering organisations and our marketing teams. You will create technical content to educate enterprise decision-makers, align technical capabilities with business goals, and accelerate sales cycles. Your role is critical in simplifying complex technical concepts, building trust, and driving adoption of our AI solutions.

 

What You Will Do

Create and Deliver Technical Content:

Develop model/product technical launch materials, technical proof points, presentation decks, demo videos, webinars, workshops, blogs, whitepapers, and sales training materials.

Enable Sales and Partners:

Equip sales teams and partners with technical knowledge to engage in deeper, more credible conversations with technical stakeholders.

Support Model Launches:

Collaborate on model launches, ensuring technical messaging is clear and impactful.

Engage with Analysts and Industry Leaders:

Participate in analyst briefings, technical advisory boards (TABs), and industry standards discussions to position Mistral AI as a thought leader.

Build Trust and Drive Adoption:

Work with solutions architects and developer relations to ensure seamless integration and implementation of our solutions through targeted technical content.

Interface with Science and Engineering:

Act as the technical liaison between engineering, science, and marketing teams, translating complex LLM concepts (including pre-training and post-training techniques) into actionable insights for enterprise audiences.

 

Who You Are

Experience: 

- 3+ years in technical marketing, solutions engineering, or a similar role, preferably in AI/ML or enterprise software.

- Experience with large language models (LLMs), including pre-training and post-training techniques, is a strong plus.

 

Technical Skills:

- Ability to understand and communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

- Familiarity with enterprise AI solutions, cloud environments, and technical sales enablement.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with a knack for storytelling and simplifying complexity.

 

Mindset:

- Collaborative, creative, and low-ego.

- Passionate about AI and its potential to transform industries.

 

Academic Background: 

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field is preferred.

 

It Would Be Ideal If You:

- Have hands-on experience with AI/ML models, especially in a technical marketing or solutions engineering capacity.

- Are comfortable working in a fast-paced, innovative environment and thrive in cross-functional teams.

- Have a track record of creating technical content that drives adoption and accelerates sales cycles.

- Are based in or willing to relocate to Paris, EU OR are open to regular travel to our Paris office. 

What We Offer

jobs.title: Software Engineer Network Automation, Data Center Fabrics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Software Engineer, Network Automation - Data Center Fabrics, you will help design and build systems for operating large-scale networks within our data centers. You will apply deep networking expertise to leaf-spine architecture, automation, testing, and production troubleshooting across Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRFs.

This is a hands-on role for a networking expert who is also comfortable building production software. Go and Kubernetes experience are helpful but not required; strong engineering fundamentals and network automation experience matter more.

What You Will Do

  • Design and evolve leaf-spine underlays, EVPN/VXLAN overlays, and tenant connectivity for multi-tenant AI infrastructure.

  • Translate data-center fabric requirements and safety properties into clear APIs, data models, validation, and automation.

  • Build reliable control-plane software that reconciles desired and observed network state.

  • Design safe change workflows with validation, dry runs, atomic updates, observability, and failure recovery.

  • Integrate with data-center switch operating systems and management APIs while maintaining vendor-neutral abstractions where practical.

  • Participate in the on-call rotation, troubleshoot active data-center network incidents, restore service, and turn root causes into lasting improvements.

  • Review designs and code, explain networking trade-offs, and help raise network engineering quality across the organization.

  • Develop lab and production tests and turn operational lessons into better software and architecture.

What We’re Looking For

  • Deep hands-on experience with Ethernet switching, IP routing, BGP-based leaf-spine fabrics, EVPN/VXLAN, and VRF-based multitenancy.

  • Strong judgment around fabric underlay and overlay design, scale, convergence, isolation, and failure modes.

  • Experience building or operating production network automation, including desired state, idempotency, concurrency, observability, and recovery.

  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals in a general-purpose language. You can design, test, debug, and review production systems and are willing to become productive in Go.

  • Experience with southbound network APIs and structured configuration, such as REST, gNMI/OpenConfig, or NETCONF.

  • Hands-on experience with major data-center network operating systems, such as Cumulus Linux, Arista EOS, SONiC, Junos, or NX-OS.

  • Strong diagnostic skills using routing and EVPN state, packet captures, counters, telemetry, and logs.

  • Clear, pragmatic communication and a collaborative approach to technical leadership.

Nice to Have

  • Experience reading, reviewing, or contributing to Go code.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes controllers, operators, CRDs, reconciliation, or Kubebuilder.

  • Experience with physical or simulated network labs such as containerlab, NVIDIA Air, EVE-NG, GNS3, or similar environments.

  • Experience with high-performance Ethernet, RoCE, InfiniBand, HPC, or large-scale GPU infrastructure.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: VP, Global Developer Relations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As our VP of Global Developer Relations, you’ll be the voice and facilitator of Mistral to the developer, scientific, and technical communities. You’ll build and scale a global DevRel strategy that fosters deep engagement, advocacy, and love for Mistral’s models and technology. Your team will build communities and educate, excite, and empower developers to adopt, innovate, and evangelize Mistral’s technology—whether they’re startups, enterprises, researchers, or open-source contributors.

You’ll work closely with Product, Research, Engineering, Marketing, Communications, and more to ensure developers have the tools, resources, and inspiration they need to succeed with Mistral.

What You Will Do

Build a Global Developer Movement

  • Develop and execute a global DevRel strategy that connects Mistral and our AI platform effectively with developers, scientists, and technologists.

  • Create authentic, developer-first engagement—focusing on education, inspiration, and community, with great content and AI tools.

  • Foster a culture of advocacy where developers naturally champion Mistral in their networks, projects, and conversations.

Engage and Inspire the Technical Community

  • Lead high-impact developer engagement initiatives, including:

    • Technical content (e.g., tutorials, blog posts, videos, documentation) that helps developers get started, optimize, and innovate with Mistral’s models.

    • Community programs (e.g., hackathons, meetups, AMAs, Discord/Slack communities) that bring together AI builders, researchers, and enthusiasts.

    • Evangelism & thought leadership (e.g., conference talks, podcasts, technical deep dives) that showcase Mistral’s unique value and capabilities.

  • Work with Product and Research teams to translate complex AI innovations into accessible, exciting, and actionable insights for developers.

Enable Developer Success, particularly for self-service adoption

  • Build scalable enablement programs (e.g., onboarding guides, SDKs, APIs, sample projects) that reduce friction for developers adopting Mistral’s models.

  • Create feedback loops between the developer community and Mistral’s Product/Engineering teams to shape the roadmap based on real-world needs.

Scale a World-Class DevRel Team

  • Hire, mentor, and lead a global team of Developer Advocates, Engineers and Evangelists - with particular strength in Europe and San Francisco

  • Define metrics and KPIs to measure the impact of DevRel (e.g., developer adoption, community growth, engagement, advocacy).

  • Lead from the front as a fantastic representative of Mistral at events, in social, and in project communities

Drive Open Source & Ecosystem Growth

  • Champion open-source contributions and collaborative innovation around Mistral’s models.

  • Partner with startups, enterprises, and academic institutions to accelerate adoption and co-innovation.

  • Identify and nurture key developer influencers, maintainers, and ambassadors who can amplify Mistral’s reach and impact.

What We're Looking For

  • Proven leadership in Developer Relations, Developer Marketing, or Technical Evangelism for a B2B technology company, preferably in AI, cloud, and open-source.

  • Deep technical credibility—ability to engage with developers, scientists, and engineers on their terms (e.g., code, research, architecture).

  • Passion for community building—a track record of growing and nurturing technical communities (e.g., open-source projects, developer forums, hackathons).

  • Strong storytelling and communication skills—ability to simplify complex concepts and inspire developers through content, talks, and interactions.

  • Strategic and operational excellence—ability to scale DevRel globally while maintaining a hands-on, authentic approach.

  • Collaborative mindset—ability to work across Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Sales to align DevRel with Mistral’s broader goals.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Experience in AI, machine learning, or large language models (LLMs).

  • Personally contributed meaningfully to open source projects and communities.

  • Led global DevRel teams in high-growth, competitive markets.

  • Personal brand or following in the developer or AI community Experience launching and scaling developer-focused products or tools.


What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As a Security Compliance Specialist, you will contribute to the development and operation of Mistral AI’s cybersecurity compliance program. You will support the implementation and maintenance of security frameworks, coordinate compliance activities across the organization, and help the company obtain and maintain the certifications required to support its growth and enterprise business.

What you will do

  • Contribute to the development and ongoing management of Mistral AI’s cybersecurity compliance program.

  • Support the definition, implementation, and maintenance of the Information Security Management System.

  • Coordinate cybersecurity compliance activities, including internal reviews, control assessments, and external audits.

  • Collect, review, and organize evidence from relevant stakeholders to demonstrate compliance with certification and regulatory requirements.

  • Help teams understand their responsibilities and expected contributions to compliance initiatives.

  • Develop and deliver cybersecurity compliance training and awareness materials.

  • Participate in cybersecurity risk assessments and support the monitoring of remediation actions.

  • Maintain compliance documentation, policies, procedures, control records, and audit materials.

  • Track changes in relevant cybersecurity standards and regulations and assess their potential impact on the organization.

  • Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Legal, and other teams to identify certifications that may support customer acquisition and business development.

  • Help evaluate and prioritize new certification initiatives based on business value, customer demand, implementation effort, and cost.

About you

  • 5+ years of experience in cybersecurity compliance, information security governance, risk management, or a related field.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance programs, certification processes, or external audits.

  • Strong understanding of cybersecurity standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, HDS, SecNumCloud, or C5.

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity regulations such as NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, LPM, or DORA.

  • Knowledge of requirements relating to sensitive or classified information, such as II 901 or IGI 1300, would be an advantage.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage documentation and coordinate multiple stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Product Manager on the Studio team, you will define and execute the product strategy for one of our squads : Workflows, Observability, AI Registry & Spaces, Harness & Agent Platform, APIs & SDKs, and more.

This role exists to help enterprises build, evaluate, and operate AI systems reliably, safely, and at scale, turning prototypes into production-ready solutions.

Our Studio product provides the infrastructure enterprises need to move from prototypes to production, including comprehensive monitoring, reliable automation, and centralized tracking of AI assets. Your squad will focus on a specific area directly impacting how enterprises deploy and manage AI systems.

You will determine how enterprises observe AI behavior, run complex workflows, version and track assets, and deploy safely across hybrid and self-hosted environments. Your work will shape the standards, traceability, and continuous improvement that turn AI into a dependable operational capability.

What You Will Do

  • Define and communicate a clear product strategy for AI tools, aligned with company goals and market opportunities.

  • Lead market and user research to uncover unmet needs and emerging trends.

  • Drive end-to-end product development, from concept to launch and iteration.

  • Partner with design and research to create effective user experiences.

  • Collaborate with marketing and sales to launch products, including pricing and positioning.

  • Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities and trade-offs.

  • Maintain a roadmap that balances short-term results and long-term goals.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience with AI products, including large language models or machine learning, and understanding of technical trade-offs.

  • Experience launching and scaling products, particularly in early-stage environments.

  • Commitment to solving real user problems, using data and qualitative insights.

  • Proven ability to align and inspire cross-functional teams without direct authority.

  • Balance between strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving.

  • Strong communication skills for executives, teams, and users.

  • Ability to thrive in dynamic environments where priorities shift.

  • Self-directed, taking initiative to navigate unknowns and own outcomes.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. jobs.title: Security Compliance, GRC Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role Summary

As a GRC Engineer, you will be at the heart of Mistral’s Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) program. You will design, implement, and maintain the technical and operational frameworks that ensure our organization meets its regulatory, security, and risk management obligations.

Your role will involve collaborating with cross-functional teams to automate compliance processes, monitor risks, and enforce governance policies. You will play a key role in ensuring that our systems, processes, and controls align with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

What you will do

  • Automate GRC workflows: Design, develop, and deploy automation scripts and tools to streamline compliance monitoring, evidence collection, risk assessments, and control testing.

  • Integrate GRC tools with existing systems: Build and maintain integrations between GRC platforms and other enterprise systems (e.g., SIEM, IAM, or ticketing tools) to enable real-time risk and compliance monitoring.

  • Develop custom dashboards and reports: Create automated dashboards to provide real-time visibility into compliance status, risk exposure, and control effectiveness for stakeholders.

  • Automate control testing and validation: Implement automated control testing for technical controls (e.g., access reviews, patch management, or configuration compliance) to reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

  • Enforce policy-as-code: Embed compliance and security policies directly into cloud and on-premise environments, ensuring consistent enforcement across systems.

  • Automate risk assessments: Develop workflows to automate the identification and prioritization of risks, such as integrating vulnerability scanning tools with GRC platforms to flag high-risk assets automatically.

  • Streamline audit evidence collection: Automate the gathering and organization of audit evidence (e.g., logs, configuration files, or access records) to support internal and external audits, reducing preparation time and minimizing errors.

  • Implement continuous compliance monitoring: Set up automated alerts and triggers for non-compliance events (e.g., unauthorized access, misconfigurations, or policy violations)

  • Automate third-party risk management: Build workflows to automate vendor risk assessments, including sending questionnaires, scoring responses, and escalating high-risk vendors for review.

  • Enhance incident response with automation: Collaborate with Security teams to automate incident response processes, such as triggering remediation workflows for identified risks or compliance gaps.

  • Maintain and optimize GRC tools: Continuously improve GRC platforms by automating routine tasks (e.g., user access reviews, control attestations) and enhancing their scalability and performance.

About you

  • 5+ years in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC), IT audit, cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Hands-on experience with GRC tools.

  • Deep knowledge of compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST CSF, COBIT, or regulatory requirements like GDPR, NIS2, or HIPAA.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation to streamline GRC processes.

  • Strong understanding of IT controls, risk assessment methodologies, and security best practices.

  • Experience with SIEM, IAM, or vulnerability management tools.

  • Familiarity with cloud security and compliance (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP security controls).

  • Ability to analyze complex data, identify trends, and develop actionable insights.

  • Creative and pragmatic approach to addressing GRC challenges.

  • Rigor in managing documentation, controls, and compliance evidence.

  • Ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, Security, Legal, and Business units.

  • Clear and concise written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and vice-versa

  • Professional proficiency in English; French proficiency is a plus..

  • Certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

Mistral succeeds when partners can confidently position, implement, support, and continuously improve Mistral AI solutions for their customers. As a member of Partner Technical Enablement, you’ll make that repeatable at scale by building reusable enablement assets, delivering training and workshops, and maintaining a tight feedback loop with Product and Engineering

 

What You Will Do

 

  • Produce and maintain high-quality, reusable technical assets: technical demos, reference architectures, and partner-adaptable pilots

  • Develop and deliver training materials and courses for our Partner training platform

  • Drive enablement at scale across all partner channels via training, conference sessions, and certification programs

  • Represent Mistral AI at partner, customer, and industry events, including executive briefings, conferences, and developer gatherings

  • Lead or support partner focused technical workshops, hackathons, and community events that drive adoption of Mistral AI solutions

  • Provide feedback and signals to GTM, Marketing, Product and Engineering teams

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

  • Experience working extensively with systems integrators or technology company ecosystems, including at least one hyperscaler ecosystem (AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure)

  • Experience building, launching, and expanding scalable partner enablement programs

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and advanced implementations

  • Skilled at leading hands-on technical sessions and workshops, including successful hackathons

  • Ability to create compelling technical demonstrations and reference implementations partners can adapt

  • Experience creating high-quality technical content across multiple formats (written, video, and audio/podcasts)

  • Proven success driving partner technical engagement and technical adoption

  • Strong Python or TypeScript skills

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with learning platforms (SCORM/LMS) and content ops: versioning, QA, release notes, analytics.

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise deployments (security, IAM, networking, observability), plus the ability to build and maintain reference code (SDKs, templates, CI/CD).

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As VP of Demand Generation, you will be the CMO's right hand and lead Mistral's global demand generation and field marketing organization.

This is a highly strategic leadership role responsible for building a world-class revenue engine that drives enterprise adoption of Mistral's products and solutions. You'll lead a global team spanning Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and ABM, partnering closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Communications, and Revenue Operations.

You'll help define how Mistral goes to market, influence company strategy, and build the programs that connect the world's leading organizations with frontier AI.

What You'll Do

  • Define and execute Mistral's global demand generation strategy aligned to company growth and revenue goals.

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team across Demand Generation, Field Marketing, and ABM.

  • Own marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline targets globally.

  • Build integrated campaigns across digital, events, paid media, executive programs, content, and partner marketing.

  • Partner closely with Sales leadership to drive pipeline generation across strategic enterprise accounts.

  • Develop and scale a best-in-class account-based marketing strategy.

  • Lead Mistral's field marketing efforts across EMEA, North America, and APAC.

  • Partner with Product Marketing and Communications to maximize the impact of product launches and flagship events.

  • Establish clear funnel metrics, reporting, and forecasting to measure marketing performance and business impact.

  • Act as a strategic advisor to the CMO and collaborate with executive leadership on company priorities.

What We're Looking For

  • 12+ years of experience in Demand Generation, Growth Marketing, or Revenue Marketing within high-growth B2B technology companies.

  • Experience leading global demand generation and field marketing organizations.

  • Proven success driving enterprise pipeline and revenue growth.

  • Deep expertise in Account-Based Marketing and enterprise go-to-market strategies.

  • Experience building and scaling teams in fast-moving environments.

  • Strong executive presence and the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

  • Exceptional operational, analytical, and leadership skills.

  • Experience in AI, cloud infrastructure, enterprise software, or developer platforms is highly preferred.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer, CyberSecurity - Montreal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

We are seeking an Applied AI Engineer to build the customer-facing cyber service and use-cases on top of our cyber harnesses. You will turn "we have agents" into "we shipped something a client uses." This role is about composing red-team/blue-team agentic workflows, configuring harnesses for real-world scenarios, and delivering value directly to clients.

Your work will bridge the gap between our foundational cyber harnesses and the agentic solutions that clients deploy. While SWE-Cyber makes the platform robust and scalable, and Pentesters run the solution and guide the direction, you will focus on building the agentic use-cases and client-facing service that solve real security problems.

 

What you will do

Client-Facing Agentic Solutions
• Compose red-team / blue-team agentic workflows for production use-cases
• Configure harnesses for cloud defense, vulnerability scanning, dynamic red-teaming, and penetration testing scenarios
• Work directly on client use-cases, translating security requirements into agentic solutions
• Turn prototype agents into deployed services that clients rely on

Context Engineering & Orchestration
• Design and implement context engineering that enables agents to operate effectively in cybersecurity domains
• Orchestrate multi-agent systems for complex security workflows
• Build the agentic layer that sits between the harness and the client

Service Delivery
• Ship fast and iterate based on client feedback and real-world performance
• Operate independently while leveraging internal building blocks and frameworks
• Collaborate with pentesters to ensure domain accuracy and effectiveness
• Partner with SWE-Cyber to ensure the platform supports your use-case requirements

 

About you

• Strong applied AI engineer with hands-on experience building agents, LLM orchestration, context engineering, evals, and RAG systems
• You ship fast, with a bias toward action and delivery
• Operate independently with a customer-led mindset
• Able to reuse internal components and bricks effectively
• Some cyber context is a real plus, but not mandatory - we can pair you with pentesters for domain depth
• Strong problem-solving abilities and attention to detail
• Excellent communication skills and collaborative attitude

It would be ideal if you also have:
• Genuine cyber or pentest knowledge
• Experience building agentic harnesses or multi-agent systems end-to-end
• Strong background in evals and benchmarking of agent systems
• Experience with security tooling or workflows
• Prior work on production AI systems in regulated or high-stakes environments
• Some of our clients have French-speaking customers, so French proficiency is a strong plus

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Customer Success, North America
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Mistral, you will be responsible for managing a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they achieve their goals using Mistral’s solutions. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, driving adoption, satisfaction, and long-term success. 

This role is ideal for those who excel in customer-facing environments, enjoy solving complex challenges, and are passionate about turning customer success into business impact.

What You Will Do

Customer Success Ownership

  • Manage a portfolio of enterprise customers, ensuring they maximize the value of Mistral’s AI solutions.

  • Build strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders, understanding their business objectives and tailoring solutions to meet their needs.

  • Lead customer onboarding, adoption, and ongoing engagement to drive product usage and satisfaction.

  • Monitor customer health metrics, identify risks, and proactively address challenges to prevent churn.

  • Collaborate with Sales to identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities based on customer needs and usage patterns.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams to gather customer feedback and influence the product roadmap.

  • Develop and deliver customer training, enablement programs, and best practices to drive adoption.

  • Conduct regular business reviews (QBRs) to align on goals, challenges, and success metrics.

Strategic Customer Guidance

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to customers, guiding them on how to leverage Mistral’s AI solutions to achieve their business outcomes.

  • Work closely with Support and Product teams to ensure seamless customer experiences, from deployment to production.

  • Create and execute customer success plans with clear KPIs, timelines, and measurable outcomes.

  • Advocate for customer needs internally, ensuring their voice is heard in product and strategic discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Share customer insights with Product, Sales, and Engineering teams to inform product improvements and strategic initiatives.

  • Clear obstacles for customers during deployment and adoption phases, accelerating time-to-value.

  • Support renewal processes, including contract negotiations, expansion discussions, and coordination with internal teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in customer-facing roles, such as Customer Success, Account Management, or Solutions Consulting, ideally in a technical or SaaS environment.

  • Proven ability to manage enterprise customer relationships, with a focus on driving adoption, satisfaction, and retention.

  • Experience working with technical products, with the ability to engage confidently with Data, IT, and Engineering teams.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, including the ability to tailor messaging for technical and executive audiences.

  • Business acumen: Ability to identify upsell and expansion opportunities while ensuring customer success.

  • Technical aptitude: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts is a plus; ability to understand and discuss technical requirements is essential.

  • Hands-on, customer-centric, collaborative, and organized, with a passion for solving complex challenges.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

 

As Mistral’s Head of Sales Enablement, EMEA, you will shape the strategic direction of our global GTM organization by scaling our selling motion. This foundational role is a pivotal opportunity to establish enablement processes that drive rep productivity and revenue growth across EMEA and beyond.

 

You will transform institutional knowledge into scalable programs, directly impacting enterprise sales effectiveness. With high visibility to the CRO and strategic influence among regional leaders, this is a chance to build from the ground up at a category-defining AI company.

 

Why This Role is Unique:

  • Strategic foundation: Establish enablement at a leading AI enterprise.

  • Global scale: Design programs that elevate selling excellence worldwide.

  • Executive influence: Partner with senior leadership to codify winning methodologies.

  • High-impact: Convert tacit expertise into structured, repeatable frameworks.

  • Efficient scaling: Build systems that leverage technology and automation.

 

What You'll Do:

  • Strategic stakeholder leadership: Partner with senior sales leaders to extract and codify best practices into enterprise-grade curriculum.

  • Program ownership: Direct the flagship onboarding program and recurring field enablement cadence.

  • Executive event leadership: Co-own delivery of major sales kickoffs, including leadership-specific enablement tracks.

  • Continuous development: Develop ongoing skills programs for lasting adoption and performance.

  • Live delivery: Facilitate high-impact enablement sessions for all sales organization levels.

  • Needs assessment: Diagnose capability gaps and translate business outcomes into targeted enablement solutions.

  • Knowledge synthesis: Transform subject matter expertise into structured, scalable frameworks.

  • Operational excellence: Manage end-to-end program logistics, including SME coordination and performance tracking.

  • Strategic input: Provide field insights to shape enablement roadmap and process improvements.

 

What We're Looking For

 

Must Have:

  • 10+ years in enterprise sales, enablement, or sales leadership (carried significant quota, managed complex enterprise deals, drove transformational sales)

  • Executive stakeholder management: Builds trust with senior, experienced sellers; navigates organizational dynamics effectively

  • Sales knowledge: Familiarity with sales methodologies (MEDDPICC, Value Selling) and practical sales practices (verticalisation)

  • Executive presence: Commands a room; adapts delivery for new hires to seasoned veterans

  • Strategic builder: Thrives in ambiguity; establishes structure and processes in emerging functions

 

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience in enterprise enablement program design and delivery

  • Business proficiency in French and English

 

Background:

  • Regional Enablement Leader, Sales Onboarding Director, or Enterprise Sales Leader in Cloud, AI, or complex B2B technology

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. The Role

Mistral AI is seeking Applied Scientists and Research Engineers to drive innovative research and collaborate with clients on complex research projects.

You will develop SOTA models across different modalities such as text, image, and speech. By developing novel methods and research ideas you will apply these models across a diverse set of use cases and domains. Working cross-functionally with both external and internal science, engineering, and product teams you will deliver high-impact AI solutions that turn the needle. We are made of researchers, engineers, product builders, ex-founders who love tackling the most complex real world problems in the industry.

 

What You Will Do

  • Run pre-training, post-training and deploy state of the art models on clusters with thousands of GPUs.

  • Work across a diverse set of complex real world problems such as robotics, engineering, finance, cybersecurity, physics and more.

  • Generate and curate data for pre-training and post-training, working on evaluations and making sure the model's performance beats expectations.

  • Develop the necessary tools and frameworks to facilitate data generation, model training, evaluation and deployment.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to tackle complex use cases using agents and retrieval pipelines.

  • Manage research projects and communications with client research teams.

     

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English with excellent communication skills — at ease explaining complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Expert with PyTorch or JAX.

  • Not afraid of contributing to a big codebase; finds their way around independently with little guidance.

  • Writes clean, readable, high-performance, fault-tolerant Python code.

  • Doesn’t need roadmaps: moves independently and navigates uncertainty with confidence.

  • Low-ego, collaborative and eager to learn.

  • Track record of success through personal projects, professional projects or academia.

Nice to have

  • Ex-founder or builder

  • PhD / Master in a relevant field (Mathematics, Physics, Machine Learning) — exceptional candidates from other backgrounds welcome.

  • Research experience in agents, multimodal models, world models, robotics, diffusion models, cybersecurity, 3D understanding/generation, or time-series analysis.

  • Experience working on large code bases or large machine learning models at scale.

  • Contributions to a large open-source or industry codebase.

  • Publications in top academic journals or conferences.

  • Enjoys improving existing code: typing, tests, CI pipelines.

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. The Role

 

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Technical Program Manager to lead and scale human data annotation operations for our Code team. In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely with researchers to define and drive data strategies. This role is a critical link between research, product, engineering, and annotation teams, and will be key in accelerating research at Mistral AI.

 

What will you do

 

  • Partner closely with code research team to develop data strategies and translate research needs into operationalizable human data annotation campaigns

  • Manage a data quality assurance team that designs and implements rigorous and scalable quality control processes, including running automated and manual checks, synthesizing actionable insights, and driving continuous improvement

jobs.title: Senior Third-Party Risk Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

Role summary

As a Senior Third-Party Risk Specialist, you will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks associated with third parties (vendors, partners, subcontractors, etc.) at Mistral. You will play a pivotal role in safeguarding our assets, data, and reputation by ensuring that our third-party relationships adhere to the highest standards of security, compliance, and resilience. You will work closely with Legal, Procurement, Security, and Operational teams to embed a proactive third-party risk management approach into our business processes.

What you will do

  • Develop and manage the third-party risk management program: Design, implement, and maintain a structured framework for identifying, assessing, and monitoring risks associated with third parties (vendors, partners, service providers, etc.).

  • Conduct third-party assessments and audits: Perform due diligence, compliance assessments, security audits, and contractual reviews to ensure third parties meet our requirements and regulatory obligations (e.g., GDPR, NIS2, DORA).

  • Collaborate with internal teams: Work with Procurement, Legal, Security, and Operations teams to integrate third-party risk requirements into vendor selection, negotiation, and monitoring processes.

  • Manage incidents and non-compliance: Identify and address gaps or incidents related to third parties, coordinating corrective actions and ensuring follow-up until resolution.

  • Raise awareness and train stakeholders: Develop and deliver training and guidance to educate internal teams on third-party risk issues and their responsibilities.

  • Maintain robust documentation: Document assessments, decisions, and actions related to third-party risk management, ensuring traceability for internal and external audits.

  • Monitor regulatory and standards evolution: Stay updated on changes in regulations (e.g., NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act, GDPR) and standards (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, ISO 27036) impacting third-party risk management, and propose adjustments to the internal framework.

  • Optimize tools and processes: Contribute to the continuous improvement of tools (e.g., third-party risk management platforms) and methodologies to enhance the program's effectiveness.

  • Align with broader resilience strategy: Ensure the third-party risk management program supports the company's overall cybersecurity and compliance objectives.

  • Contract redlining and negotiation skills: Ability to review, edit, and negotiate contractual terms to align with security and compliance requirements.

About you

  • 7+ years in third-party risk management, cybersecurity compliance, information security governance, or a related field.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity compliance programs, certification processes, or external audits.

  • Practical knowledge of standards and frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIST SP 800-53, or regulations like NIS2, DORA, GDPR.

  • Proficiency in risk assessment methodologies (e.g., EBIOS RM, ISO 27005).

  • Familiarity with cybersecurity regulations such as NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act, LPM, or DORA.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage documentation and coordinate multiple stakeholders.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across technical, legal, commercial, and operational teams.

  • Professional proficiency in English; French proficiency is a plus.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Head of FDE Learning Programs
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

  • Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

  • Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

  • Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

  • Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

  • Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

  • Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

  • Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

How We Work in Solutions

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

 - Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

 - Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

 - Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

 - Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

 - Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

 - Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

 - Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

 - Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

 - Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

 - Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.


HOW WE WORK IN SOLUTIONS

 - We care about people and outputs.

 - What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

 - Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

 - Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

 - We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

 - No politics. Low ego, high standards.

 - We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.
   


ABOUT YOU

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

 - 

 - You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

 - You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

 - 

 - You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

 - You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

 - You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

 - You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

 - You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

 - You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.
   


IDEALLY, YOU HAVE

 - Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

 - Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

 - Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

 - Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

 - Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

 - Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

 - Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

 - Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

 - Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

 - Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.
   


WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.




WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, Code Agents Infra
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

This role focuses on building and operating the end-to-end execution, training, and data infrastructure that powers Mistral’s agentic models and coding assistants. You will be a core contributor to our agent research stack: designing scalable systems for synthetic data generation, building ultra-fast training and RL execution environments, and maintaining high-throughput execution engines.

You will tackle the engineering challenges at every step of the agent lifecycle: from orchestrating 1M+ concurrent and short-lived sandboxes for untrusted code execution to optimizing agent training codebases, distributed trajectory collection pipelines, and dataset processing workflows across massive hybrid and multi-cloud clusters.

What You Will Do

  • Large-Scale Sandboxing Infrastructure: Design, deploy, and operate our high-throughput sandboxing platform, executing LLM-generated untrusted code across over 1 million isolated environments concurrently for model evaluation and interactive RL environments.

  • Agent Data Generation Pipelines: Architect and scale high-throughput pipelines for synthetic code generation, agent trajectories, rollouts, and self-play data collection to power post-training and RL loops.

  • Training Codebase & Systems Optimization: Optimize agent training codebases and distributed execution runtimes (PyTorch, Ray, SLURM/Kubernetes) to minimize multi-step rollout overhead, improve GPU utilization, and eliminate scaling bottlenecks.

  • Low-Latency Orchestration & Warm Pooling: Reduce sandbox cold-start times to sub-second levels using container warm pools, snapshot/restore technology (e.g., CRIU, microVMs), and optimized image delivery layers across hybrid clusters.

  • Multi-Cluster Queueing & Resource Allocation: Implement Kubernetes-native custom controllers, CRDs, and queuing systems to dynamically route short-lived evaluation, synthetic data, and agent execution tasks across diverse hardware fleets.

  • Isolation, Security & Security Boundary: Ensure strict multi-tenant network and process isolation for untrusted agent code using container/sandboxing runtimes (e.g., gVisor, Firecracker) and default-deny network postures.

  • Operational Excellence: Maintain high availability, telemetry, and automated self-healing across millions of transient jobs while participating in on-call rotations for critical agent training and execution pipelines.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of experience in Systems Engineering, Distributed Systems, Cloud Infrastructure, or MLOps supporting LLM/RL workloads.

  • Data & Pipeline Engineering: Proven experience building high-throughput data processing and generation pipelines for large-scale datasets (e.g., Ray, Spark, custom distributed queues).

  • Deep experience with Kubernetes & Container Tech: Strong expertise writing custom K8s operators/controllers, managing Linux cgroups/namespaces, and optimizing Docker image layers and distribution systems.

  • High-Performance Software Engineering: Advanced proficiency in Python, Go, C++ or Rust, with a track record of profiling and optimizing high-performance ML or backend systems codebases.

  • Sandboxing & Isolation Technologies: Hands-on experience with lightweight virtualization, container runtimes, or WASM (e.g., Docker, gVisor, Firecracker).

  • Queueing & Scheduling: Deep familiarity with task queue systems, resource schedulers, and low-latency queuing architectures for high-volume, short-lived workloads.

  • Comfort with Ambiguity: Passion for working directly alongside AI researchers to rapidly turn frontier agent ideas into scalable, production-grade infrastructure.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager, Science
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the Role

As a Product Marketing Manager, Science, you will serve as the strategic bridge between Mistral's Science organisation and our Marketing, Product and Go-to-Market teams. Your mission is to translate cutting-edge AI research into compelling product narratives, technical positioning and customer-facing content that helps developers, enterprise buyers and industry influencers understand the value of our models.

You will work closely with researchers and engineers to provide industry-leading thought leadership, bring new models and capabilities to market, and ensure launches are technically accurate, commercially relevant, and easy to understand. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep technical curiosity with exceptional communication and storytelling skills.

What You Will Do

Drive Technical Product Marketing

  • Develop positioning, messaging and technical narratives for Mistral's foundation models and research innovations.

  • Translate complex AI concepts—including pre-training, post-training, reasoning, evaluation and inference—into clear, compelling customer value.

  • Partner with Science, Product and Engineering throughout the product development lifecycle to ensure technical accuracy and market relevance.

Lead Technical Launches

  • Own the technical marketing components of model launches, including launch messaging, technical blogs, documentation, presentations and demos.

  • Collaborate with Product Marketing, Communications and Developer Relations to deliver cohesive go-to-market campaigns.

Create World-Class Technical Content

  • Produce technical blogs, whitepapers, benchmark analyses, presentations, demo videos, webinars and workshops.

  • Build sales enablement materials that help technical and commercial teams confidently communicate Mistral's differentiated capabilities.

  • Develop content that supports enterprise buyers, developers and AI practitioners throughout their evaluation journey.

Enable Internal and External Audiences

  • Equip Sales, Solutions Engineering and Partnerships teams with technical messaging, competitive insights and customer-facing assets.

  • Support customer briefings, executive meetings and strategic technical conversations.

  • Partner closely with Developer Relations and Solutions Architects to ensure consistent technical messaging across all customer touchpoints.

Represent Mistral's Technical Leadership

  • Support analyst briefings, technical advisory boards and industry events.

  • Help position Mistral as a thought leader by communicating advances in frontier AI research to external audiences.

Who You Are

Experience

  • 5+ years in Product Marketing, Technical Product Marketing, Solutions Engineering or Technical Marketing within AI, machine learning, cloud infrastructure or enterprise software.

  • Experience working closely with research or engineering teams to launch highly technical products.

  • Strong understanding of large language models and modern AI systems. Experience with model training, evaluation, or inference is highly desirable.

Technical Skills

  • Ability to quickly understand complex technical concepts and translate them into clear business value.

  • Excellent written communication with experience creating technical content for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Familiarity with enterprise AI deployments, APIs, cloud infrastructure and developer ecosystems.

Mindset

  • Highly collaborative and comfortable working across Science, Product, Marketing and Go-to-Market teams.

  • Curious, analytical and passionate about frontier AI.

  • Low ego, pragmatic and excited by fast-moving environments.

Academic Background

Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, AI, or a related technical discipline is preferred.

It Would Be Ideal If You

  • Have experience working directly with AI researchers or ML engineering teams.

  • Have launched AI models, developer platforms, or highly technical enterprise products.

  • Have created technical product marketing content that influenced customer adoption or enterprise purchasing decisions.

  • Enjoy translating breakthrough research into stories that resonate with customers.

  • Are based in Paris, willing to relocate, or open to traveling regularly to our Paris office.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

For the most up-to-date details on benefits available in your location, please refer to our Benefits page.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy matters to us. You can learn more about how we handle your personal data in our Applicant Privacy Policy.
